identity.name: agent
identity.description: Pi agent home under ~/.pi/agent: settings, extensions, skills, agents, observability, and npm-installed packages — not a conventional application repo.

whether denied last30days skill entry still loads via package tools only

leadContext.note: Lead is session-rich; Pass A stays project/static and cross-checks lead friction against post-P0 on-disk harness structure.

p0Context.note: Disk advanced after packet snapshot. P0 commits bef82d7 (unlock skills, AGENTS.md, gitignore whitelist) and 9398367 (drop __pycache__). Uncommitted: APPEND_SYSTEM.md → HARNESS.md pointer; untracked agent/git/.

packetFacts.note: Packet is pre-P0 snapshot; diskFacts supersede for residual scoring.

recentCommits: bef82d7 fix(agent): unlock skills, add AGENTS.md, version harness intent

settings.piLeanCtx: package-installed; local config under extensions/pi-lean-ctx/; not listed in settings.extensions array

last30days.policy: denied via settings.skills; AGENTS/HARNESS require slim ~5–8KB top-level

taskUnderstanding.rationale: AGENTS.md + HARNESS.md + dirty APPEND_SYSTEM form a coherent contract (skills policy, tool execution, git track table). Gap: HARNESS.md not in git so clone/install consumers only see AGENTS; SYSTEM.md/README allowlisted but absent.

controlledExecution.rationale: skills filter no longer blankets deny; CE-lite triggers reachable. Residual: 3 local extensions documented in AGENTS but not enabled; no hooks/CI to enforce policy; last30days still a load footgun if filter regresses.

changeValidation.rationale: Unchanged by P0. No CI, pre-commit, core.hooksPath, Makefile, or package test script. harness-doctor exists as a skill only. Lead observed rare node --test — not wired as harness gate.

reliableDelivery.rationale: 395 agent paths tracked; remote present; P0 whitelist real. Residual delivery holes: HARNESS.md ignored; inventory ignored/stale; ~16MB last30days binaries tracked; 221MB untracked agent/git/ commit risk; dirty APPEND.

learningCapture.rationale: observability/history.jsonl has 4 token_metrics lines; no skill-load, doctor, or install events. harness-inventory.json stale since 2026-07-30 and not versioned. memory/ holds ad-hoc dumps, not a curated loop.

findings.title: No durable agent instruction contract
findings.evidence: agent/AGENTS.md tracked (2887B); agent/HARNESS.md exists on disk (2061B); APPEND_SYSTEM points at HARNESS.md (dirty).

findings.title: settings.skills blanket deny blocked CE-lite
findings.evidence: settings.skills == ["!**/last30days/**"] only; 44 skill SKILL.md on disk.

findings.title: Root gitignore denied almost all harness intent
findings.evidence: .gitignore whitelists settings, AGENTS, APPEND_SYSTEM, skills/**, agents/**, extensions/**, context-prune/**.
findings.residual: HARNESS.md and harness-inventory.json still under deny-all; SYSTEM.md/README allowlisted but missing.

findings.title: No validation command surface, hooks, or CI for harness changes
evidence: core.hooksPath unset
no .github/workflows, .pre-commit-config.yaml, Makefile, or agent/package.json
harness-doctor skill present but not an automated gate
lead saw only opportunistic node --test, not a harness check
findings.impact: P0-class settings/gitignore regressions can ship without a mechanical check.
findings.remediation: Add a minimal doctor/preflight script + optional pre-commit or CI job: validate settings.json JSON, skills filter does not contain !**, required files tracked, extensions paths exist.

findings.title: Observability and inventory not operationalized
evidence: observability/history.jsonl: 4 lines, token_metrics only
harness-inventory.json generated 2026-07-30T16:03:28+0100, gitignored, not refreshed after P0
findings.impact: Cannot verify skill-load health or package drift from repo history.
findings.remediation: Refresh inventory post-P0; whitelist or export a slim inventory artifact; emit skill-load/doctor events into history or a tracked summary.

findings.title: Working tree was an untracked skills dump
findings.evidence: 395 agent paths tracked after bef82d7/9398367; __pycache__ removed from index.
findings.residual: last30days bulk binaries still tracked — PH-A-010.

findings.title: Project profile empty because tracking ≠ harness surface
findings.evidence: skills/agents/extensions now visible to git; packet profile emptiness is stale relative to disk.

findings.title: transcript-pruner.ts untracked
findings.evidence: extensions/** whitelisted; transcript-pruner.ts tracked and listed in settings.extensions.

findings.title: HARNESS.md is live contract but still gitignored and untracked
evidence: git check-ignore -v agent/HARNESS.md → .gitignore:2:*
git ls-files agent/HARNESS.md empty
APPEND_SYSTEM.md (dirty) and AGENTS.md both declare HARNESS.md as harness contract
HARNESS.md itself says track HARNESS.md in repo
findings.impact: Fresh clone/install misses the tool-execution and skills-policy contract APPEND_SYSTEM points at.
findings.remediation: Add !agent/HARNESS.md to .gitignore and git add -f agent/HARNESS.md; commit with APPEND_SYSTEM.md pointer change.

findings.title: last30days skill tree ~16MB tracked including media binaries
evidence: 124 tracked files under agent/skills/last30days
SKILL.md 222272 bytes
tracked assets: dog-original.jpeg 4.0MB, aging-portrait.jpeg 2.8MB, swimmom-mockup.jpeg 2.8MB, dog-as-human.png 2.5MB, claude-code-rap.mp3 2.4MB
settings denies skill load; AGENTS/HARNESS require slim ~5–8KB top-level + references/
findings.impact: Repo bloat, noisy diffs, accidental context load if skills filter regresses to allow-all.
findings.remediation: Untrack assets/* and non-essential scripts from this harness repo (or replace with package dependency); slim SKILL.md; keep settings deny until slim.

findings.title: Local extensions claimed in AGENTS but not enabled in settings
evidence: On disk: tool-trimmer.ts, session-index.ts, invest-tools.ts, transcript-pruner.ts, pi-lean-ctx/
settings.extensions enables only transcript-pruner.ts among local paths
AGENTS.md lists tool-trimmer, session-index, invest-tools as Local extensions without enablement caveat
findings.impact: Operators believe trim/index/invest hooks are active; sessions may lack them.
findings.remediation: Either enable the three TS extensions in settings.extensions or mark them optional/disabled in AGENTS.md; document pi-lean-ctx load path (package vs local).

findings.title: gitignore allowlists missing SYSTEM.md and README.md
evidence: !.gitignore entries for agent/SYSTEM.md and README.md
neither file exists on disk
findings.impact: Dead allowlist entries; no root README for clone consumers.
findings.remediation: Add a short root README describing install/intent track table, or drop dead allowlist lines; only add SYSTEM.md if it has a distinct role from HARNESS/AGENTS.

findings.title: Untracked agent/git/ nested mirror (~221MB) not ignored
evidence: ?? agent/git/ in status
du -sh agent/git → 221M
git check-ignore does not ignore agent/git (directory traversal !*/)
findings.impact: Accidental git add agent/git would explode the config repo.
findings.remediation: Add agent/git/ to .gitignore; delete or relocate the mirror outside the repo.

findings.title: P0 APPEND_SYSTEM→HARNESS pointer uncommitted
evidence: git status: M agent/APPEND_SYSTEM.md
diff changes harness contract path from AGENTS.md to HARNESS.md
findings.impact: Tracked APPEND still points at AGENTS.md while live file points at untracked HARNESS.md — split-brain for anyone reading HEAD vs worktree.
findings.remediation: Commit APPEND_SYSTEM.md together with HARNESS.md whitelist+add (PH-A-009).

recommendations.title: Version HARNESS.md and commit APPEND_SYSTEM pointer
actions: Verify git check-ignore agent/HARNESS.md is empty and ls-files shows it

recommendations.title: Purge last30days media and slim skill entry
actions: git rm -r --cached agent/skills/last30days/assets (or whole non-slim tree)
Ignore assets binaries; keep deny in settings until SKILL.md ≤ ~8KB
Prefer package-provided last30days tools over vendored tree in this repo

recommendations.title: Wire a harness preflight gate
actions: Script: JSON-parse settings.json; assert skills filter has no blanket !**; assert AGENTS.md+HARNESS.md tracked; assert each settings.extensions path exists
Optional: pre-commit hook or gh workflow on agent/** paths
Document one command in AGENTS.md (e.g. harness-doctor / npm script)

recommendations.title: Resolve extension enablement drift
actions: Enable tool-trimmer/session-index/invest-tools or document as disabled
Align AGENTS.md Local extensions list with settings.extensions

recommendations.title: Ignore agent/git; refresh or drop inventory artifact
actions: Regenerate harness-inventory.json after P0; whitelist !agent/harness-inventory.json if it is a delivery artifact, else treat as local-only and document

recommendations.title: Fill or remove dead allowlists; thin README
actions: Add root README.md for clone/install map or remove !README.md
Drop !agent/SYSTEM.md unless a distinct SYSTEM surface is planned

softwareFluencyNarrative.summary: Post-P0 the harness crossed from 'invisible config dump' to a partially versioned agent home: skills unlocked, AGENTS.md present, gitignore whitelist real, 395 paths tracked, remote set. Fluency is still mid-low because the declared contract file (HARNESS.md) is not delivered via git, validation is absent, last30days binaries dominate weight, and learning signals (inventory/obs) are stale or token-only.

byDimension.taskUnderstanding: Contract docs exist and cross-link; delivery incomplete without tracked HARNESS.md.
byDimension.controlledExecution: Policy filter fixed; enablement drift and no enforcement gate remain.
byDimension.changeValidation: Still the weakest dimension — doctor skill ≠ gate.
byDimension.reliableDelivery: Much improved tracking; residual ignore holes and bulk skill tree.

aligned: Lead validation-behavior (rare node --test) matches absence of harness CI/hooks (PH-A-004).
Lead friction around skills/policy is explained by pre-P0 blanket deny; disk now open except last30days.
Session-rich lead cannot substitute for missing project validation surface.
diverged: Packet trackedFiles=3 and agentInstructions=none are stale vs disk (395 tracked, AGENTS+HARNESS present).
Lead does not surface HARNESS.md gitignore hole or last30days binary bulk — Pass A disk-only findings.
crossCheckWithLead.useLeadFor: Session friction and observed tool habits only; do not score delivery from lead alone.
